scenarios.text: A raider charges a colonist and lands a heavy club swing. The colonist is knocked back two cells across the floor and staggers. A moment later a pirate's rifle round hits another colonist, who slides a cell sideways.
scenarios.expect: reject: only explosions throw; melee and bullets move nobody

scenarios.text: Raiders stand on a covered pit trap. A colonist's EMP grenade bursts right over them and a smoke canister follows. The cover cracks apart and two raiders drop into the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: an EMP or smoke burst never breaks a pit cover

scenarios.text: A mechanoid stands on a covered pit when an EMP burst goes off on it, then smoke rolls over the same cells. The cover stays whole and the mech stays standing on it, dazed but not falling.
scenarios.expect: accept: EMP and smoke bursts leave a cover whole

scenarios.text: An earlier blast left steel and a dead boar on the floor of an open pit. A second grenade lands at the pit's edge. The steel and the boar stay where they lie at the bottom while the goods on the rim fly.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods and corpses already on a pit floor are never thrown

scenarios.text: A dead thrumbo lies outside the colony wall beside some dropped weapons. A mortar shell lands next to it. The weapons fly and bounce off the wall, but the thrumbo carcass stays exactly where it fell.
scenarios.expect: accept: a corpse of body size 2.5 or more is never thrown

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a storeroom with a colonist and a pile of components near it. The colonist is thrown about three cells and stops at the wall, while the components arc high, spin and keep bouncing off walls, ending far beyond where the colonist landed.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods fly wild and rebound off walls; people are thrown about three cells and stop

scenarios.text: A frag grenade lands beside a stack of crates in the storeroom. The crates stay closed with everything still inside, and one small crate skids a cell back into the empty space behind it.
scenarios.expect: accept: closed containers keep their goods and may be shoved a little

scenarios.text: The player opens Mod Settings and switches off only the container shove, then lights a flammable gas cloud in the storeroom. No clump goes off at all and the goods on the floor do not move, though the gas chain was left switched on.
scenarios.expect: reject: each part switches off cleanly with the rest still working

scenarios.text: A modded rocket whose tuning sets its impact factor to 0 hits beside a raider standing near a wooden door. The raider is thrown, hits the door, and stops there with no injury from the impact, and the door is unmarked by the collision.
scenarios.expect: accept: an impact factor of 0 makes its throws hit walls and pawns harmlessly

scenarios.text: On a game with default Mod Settings, a mortar shell lands between a muffalo (body size 2.4) and an elephant (body size 4). The muffalo is thrown away; the elephant stays where it stood.
scenarios.expect: accept: the default body-size limit 2.5 spares bigger pawns and throws smaller ones

scenarios.text: A grenade kills a raider outright in a cluttered workshop. His body is flung through the air in a high spinning arc along with the scattered tools, bouncing off a wall before settling.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn the blast kills flies as a corpse among the goods

scenarios.text: A raider stands two cells from an open pit when a colonist's grenade lands at his feet. He is flung toward the pit and drops onto its floor.
scenarios.expect: accept: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor

scenarios.text: A colonist ordered to haul wood to a stockpile takes the shortest route, which crosses an open pit, and walks straight off the edge into it.
scenarios.expect: reject: no colonist walks into a pit by ordinary pathing

scenarios.text: A colonist wearing a charged shield belt stands near a flammable gas cloud when it catches. A small burst goes off beside her; she is shoved one cell aside unhurt while her belt does not stop it.
scenarios.expect: accept: a gas clump shoves a pawn one cell unhurt and a shield belt does not stop the shove

scenarios.text: A flammable gas cloud spread over a storeroom is lit at one end. The whole cloud detonates at once as one big blast from its middle, throwing everything outward from that single point.
scenarios.expect: reject: gas goes off clump by clump, never one centroid blast

scenarios.text: A colonist is standing in a stream of the Cauldron's gas when a spark lights it. The gas simply burns as a sheet of fire; no little bursts go off and the steel nearby does not move.
scenarios.expect: reject: the Cauldron's gas carries the flammable tag and goes off clump by clump

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a colonist behind a sandbag line. She is lifted toward the sandbags and stops against them, landing on the near side.
scenarios.expect: reject: a mortar beside a colonist throws them about three cells, over sandbags

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a colonist into the storeroom wall. He rebounds off it and skitters back across the room like a loose stack before coming to rest.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall; people never rebound

scenarios.text: An incendiary shell lands in a stockpile full of cloth and steel. Fires start but not one stack moves, and a colonist next to it stays planted.
scenarios.expect: reject: fire blasts throw too, at half

scenarios.text: A bomb goes off in a storeroom full of shelves of goods. The floor stacks fly but every item on the shelves stays neatly in place.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves protect nothing

scenarios.text: Six mortar shells fall into a packed 10x10 stockpile. Most stacks fly, but a block of stacks near the far edge of the blast just sits still while their neighbours are flung around them.
scenarios.expect: reject: every loose good the blast reaches moves, none skipped over a cap

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in a pile of silver. The silver stacks blink out with a puff of dust and reappear a few cells away, with nothing seen in the air between.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods never vanish and reappear under a dust puff

scenarios.text: A colonist is thrown by a grenade across a room toward an open pit, and the player watches him sail over the pit and land on the far rim.
scenarios.expect: reject: nothing is thrown across a pit; it falls to the floor

scenarios.text: A blast threw a stack of medicine onto a pit floor. The player orders it hauled, but the medicine stays forbidden and no colonist ever goes down to fetch it.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods in a pit stay retrievable; a colonist can fetch them back

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a colonist and she sails up in a clean arc toward a cell three tiles away. A drop pod's wreck crashes onto that exact cell mid-flight, so she smoothly curves to the open cell next to it and lands there, stunned but fine.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn lands on the cell chosen at the blast and is never re-targeted

scenarios.text: Six mortar shells walk across a packed 10x10 stockpile on the full mod list at normal speed. The goods fly beautifully and the average frame rate holds up; only once, as the third shell lands, the game freezes for roughly a tenth of a second before carrying on.
scenarios.expect: reject: no frame may exceed 50 ms through the barrage; one stall fails the budget

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a narrow corridor full of medicine and steel. The stacks leap up in high arcs, spinning fast, and slam into the end wall, where each one drops straight down and lies there.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods rebound off walls keeping about 70 percent of their speed until spent; stopping at the first wall fails

scenarios.text: A frag grenade lands in the middle of a crowded storeroom. The stacks next to it arc and tumble across the room, while the stacks at the edge of the blast simply blink a few cells over at once with a little dust, so the whole room is cleared in the same moment.
scenarios.expect: reject: every good the blast reaches must fly; far stacks hopping instantly while near ones fly is the named failure

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a row of storage: an open shelf empties across the floor, a fridge keeps its meals and jolts in place, and a big 2x1 deep-storage unit full of steel slides a whole cell sideways with its contents intact.
scenarios.expect: reject: only a 1x1 closed container may slide; a larger container sliding is a named failure

scenarios.text: A raider tosses an explosive from a weapons mod into the colonists' trench. The blast throws people and goods, visibly, but noticeably shorter than a vanilla frag grenade of the same size would, at roughly two-thirds strength.
scenarios.expect: reject: another mod's damaging explosion throws at 100 percent by default, not some other percent

scenarios.text: A raider stands on a covered pit trap when an incendiary shell bursts right on top of him. The cover blackens and the ground around it catches fire, but the cover holds and he runs off burning.
scenarios.expect: reject: a damaging or fire blast breaks a pit cover and whoever stands on it falls

scenarios.text: A grenade beside an open pit throws a stack of components straight toward it. The stack arcs over and comes to rest on the very edge of the pit, on the rim cell, where a colonist can pick it up without going down.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor; landing on the rim is a named failure

scenarios.text: Raiders charge the base across a field with a hidden covered pit; the lead raider runs onto it and drops through. Later, colonists hauling in from the same field always route around the pit cell, even when it is the shortest way.
scenarios.expect: accept: an enemy may walk into a pit hidden from it; colonists never enter by ordinary pathing

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a storeroom. A small crate pressed against the back wall shudders hard in place without moving, its goods still inside, while a second crate in the open slides one cell away from the blast.
scenarios.expect: accept: a 1x1 closed container slides one cell if the cell behind is free, else jolts in place; contents stay
